verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way for a designer to update Trello card status from inside a design tool. Power-Ups work the other way: they 'integrate your favorite apps right into Trello' and pull outside data into Trello. The REST API and Power-Up SDK are developer building blocks, and the MCP server targets AI tools, not design tools. None of these earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
